rationale: Multiple transaction functions (LinkContractCreate, LinkContractBiding, LinkContractDeal, LinkContractClose) call time.Now() to generate timestamps that are stored in bill.VersionTime, which is then written to the ledger via putBill calling stub.PutState. This creates nondeterminism as different peers will record different timestamps.
